messages:
ops-bot: Pager triggered (P1) — EU embeddings latency spike. Affected: embeddings API (eu-west). Page: @oncall-maria. Link: https://pager.example/incident/4633456789

oncall-maria: Ack. Joining bridge. Starting initial triage. I'll collect traffic patterns and rollbacks.

kevin-sre: I'm seeing genqueue pods OOM/killing on node g4-eu-03, GC churn 200-400ms. CPU high. Confirmed small percentage of 5xx for embeddings since 09:12 UTC.

oncall-maria: Routing fallback engaged to cached embeddings on edge for ~50% of traffic. Immediate customer impact: higher latency (500-800ms) and intermittent 5xx. No data loss.

linda-product: We need a short customer-facing status page notice. Drafting below — please comment.

linda-product:
```
Investigating: Increased latency for embeddings in EU (detected 09:10 UTC)
Status: Degraded performance
Impact: Some embeddings requests in EU may experience higher latency and intermittent errors. No customer data loss has been identified.
What we're doing: Engineers are investigating and routing traffic to cached fallbacks to mitigate impact. We'll post updates every 30 minutes.
```

legal-team: Quick note — avoid committing exact error rates or customer names in public page. Replace exact percentages with "a small percentage" and remove specific node names. Otherwise OK.

linda-product: Updated per legal. New draft below:
```
Investigating: Increased latency for embeddings in EU (detected 09:10 UTC)
Status: Degraded performance
Impact: Some embeddings requests in EU may experience higher latency and intermittent errors. No customer data loss has been identified.
What we're doing: Engineers are investigating and routing traffic to cached fallbacks to mitigate impact. Next update in 30 minutes.
```

kevin-sre: Root cause suspected: memory leak from recent tokenizer caching change (PR #4512). Rolling back that change on EU canary now. ETA 25-40m.

oncall-maria: Sounds good. I'll start the status page update flow. @ops-bot please publish initial page when ready.

ops-bot: Publishing initial status page update now — https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/4633456789 (published 09:28 UTC)

sean-support: Notifying top-tier customers via email template. Copy: "We're investigating degraded embeddings performance in EU; no data loss; updates every 30m." Sent to pilot customers.

kevin-sre: Canary rollback complete, genqueue pods stable, error rate dropping. Monitoring for 10m.

oncall-maria: Latency back to baseline ~09:52 UTC. Planning to keep monitoring for 30m before marking resolved. Preparing resolve copy.

linda-product: Resolve draft:
```
Resolved: Embeddings latency spike in EU (09:10–09:52 UTC)
Status: Resolved
Impact: Affected embeddings requests may have experienced higher latency and intermittent errors. No customer data loss.
What we did: Rolled back a tokenizer cache change causing memory pressure and restarted affected nodes. Traffic was routed to fallbacks during mitigation.
What we're doing next: Postmortem and mitigation plan (fix + test) to be published within 72 hours.
```

legal-team: Approve resolve copy.

ops-bot: Publishing resolved update now — https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/4633456789 (updated 09:55 UTC). Incident set to resolved.

oncall-maria: Closing bridge. Filing postmortem ticket and assigning to kevin for RCA. Thanks all :tada:

kevin-sre: I'll open the PR revert follow-up and add unit tests for the tokenizer cache. Assigned to me.

sean-support: Sending final customer note to pilots and updating internal support KB.

ops-bot: Incident closed. Thread archived.
